title: Sharpen Your Sword for Litigation: Incumbent Strategic Reaction to the Threat of Entry
eligible_reason: Staggered binary treatment: piv_sub_d switches on in the year an NDA (branded drug) receives its first Paragraph IV challenge (piv_yr), with challenge cohorts 2001-2016 inside the 1991-2016 panel and 818 never-challenged NDAs plus 54 challenged after 2016. The headline specifications (Tables 3, 4, 5 col 1) are static TWFE with NDA FE and year x ATC-3 FE but ALSO drug-age FE (i.age) in every column, which the protocol treats as an excluded nonredundant additive FE; they are recorded as near-misses. One main-text specification satisfies all rules: Table 5 column 2, reghdfe no_nda_atc3 piv_sub_d, a(applicant_id year#atc_level3_id) on a firm x ATC-3 x year panel (firm group FE, year x therapeutic-class FE, no controls, no age FE, two-way clustering), with the firm's first-challenge year as the adoption date and unattacked firms as never-treated. Eligible on that specification; flagged for the lead because the eligible spec is a secondary outcome.
design_notes: master_data_sample.dta: NDA-year panel, 14,641 obs, 1,454 NDAs, 286 firms, 1991-2016; piv_sub_d = (year >= piv_yr) verified for 100% of rows, no switch-off. piv_yr distribution (NDAs): 2001:1, 2003:1, 2004-2016: 34-65 per year (578 total), 2017-2020: 54 (not yet treated in window), missing (never challenged): 818. Headline spec Tables 3-5: reghdfe Y piv_sub_d, a(i.applicant_id appl_no i.year##atc_level3_id i.age) vce(cluster appl_no); outcomes no_sim_pat, no_pat_ob, share_continuation (Table 3), newpat, external, reused (Table 4), no_prod_ob (Table 5 col 1). Tables 8, 9, A6, A10: piv_sub_d interacted with moderators (excluded). Table 7: generic_d on new_pat_d##post_piv (excluded, interaction + proprietary). Table 6, Figure 8, Table A8: proprietary litigation data (set to missing). Table A7: bacondecomp on no_pat_ob and share_continuation (Goodman-Bacon decomposition, appendix). Figure A2: randomization inference over placebo challenge dates. Table 5 col 2: firm x ATC-3 x year panel built in table_5.do lines 27-70 from temp/temp_no_ndas_per_applicant_per_atc3.dta (supplementary_files.do line 405; from data/orange_book.dta + data/drug_with_atpcode.dta) and temp/temp_appl_no_piv_yr.dta (supplementary_files.do line 343; from data/paragraph_iv_updated2021.dta + orange_book.dta): piv_yr = firm's earliest first-PIV year, 'attacked' assigned to the ATC-3 class(es) of the earliest-challenged drug(s); unattacked ATC-3s of attacked firms dropped; piv_yr > 2015 dropped; piv_sub_d = (year >= piv_yr); 1,350 singletons dropped by reghdfe; N = 6,383, 362 firms, 103 ATC-3 classes.
n_eligible_specs_note: 0 after lead ruling 2026-11-01 (additional age fixed effects); Table 5 col 2 (no age FE, replicated exactly) and the 7 age-FE headline specs recorded as near-misses
n_adoption_cohorts_note: NDA panel: first-PIV years 2001, 2003, 2004-2016 observed within 1991-2016 (14 cohorts with both pre and post). Table 5 col 2 firm-ATC3 panel: cohorts 2004-2015 (12).
never_treated_note: 818 never-challenged NDAs (plus 54 challenged 2017-2020, not yet treated in window); in Table 5 col 2, unattacked firms.
always_treated_note: Two NDAs with piv_yr 2001/2003 may be treated from their first observed year if approved after 2001; check in replication.
modern_estimators_named: goodman_bacon_decomposition (bacondecomp, Table A7; diagnostic, not a CSA/BJS/SA/dCDH estimate)
preferred_spec_note: The paper's headline is Table 3 col 2 (no_pat_ob, near-miss due to age FE). The eligible Table 5 col 2 is a secondary portfolio-composition outcome; preferred flag = n.

published_estimates.source: log/main tables and figures/table_5.log (authors' run on original data); verify against published Table 5 col 2

data_access_note: README labels data/ a 'synthetic dataset with some of the key variables', but master_data_sample.dta matches the shipped logs exactly (N = 14,641; 1,454 NDA clusters; 286 firms; reghdfe constants in the Table 3 log are reproduced to 6 digits by the file's outcome means and treatment share), so it appears to be the real analysis file with proprietary Paragraph IV Report variables (litigation, complaint texts) set to missing. Recommend confirming with the authors. Orange Book, ATC, FDA Paragraph IV list, patents, Medicare inputs are public and shipped.
data_files: proprietary-derived files shipped with variables set to missing: paragraph_four_final.dta, paragraph_iv_updated2021_1stpiv_lit_yr.dta, temp_case_id.dta, temp_complaint_texts.dta, temp_manual.dta, input_patent_complaint_text.dta
screener_notes: Judgment call for the lead: the paper's headline TWFE (Tables 3-5 col 1) includes drug-age FE in every column, which PROTOCOL Sec. 2 excludes as a nonredundant additive FE; I recorded those 7 specs as near-misses and kept only Table 5 col 2 (firm x ATC-3 panel, no age FE) as eligible. Table 5 col 2 needs the firm-ATC3 count panel built from shipped public inputs via supplementary_files.do (Stata). Cohorts 2004-2015, never-treated firms present, two-way clustering by firm and ATC-3 (103 ATC-3 clusters). Authors report a Goodman-Bacon decomposition (Table A7) but no CSA/BJS/SA/dCDH estimates.
lead_ruling: 2026-11-01 (team lead): the drug-age fixed effects (i.age) in every reported column of the paper's DiD design (Tables 3, 4, 5 col 1, A1, A3-A6) are additional nonredundant additive FE, excluded under PROTOCOL Section 2; paper recorded as a near-miss, no spec JSONs kept. Replicator's note: Table 5 column 2 (reghdfe no_nda_atc3 piv_sub_d, a(applicant_id year#atc_level3_id)) has NO age FE and was the screener's single eligible spec; it was replicated exactly (-0.0819096) and is archived in ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2023.00900/archived_specs/ and archived_output/ pending the lead's confirmation that the paper-level exclusion covers this secondary firm x ATC-3 regression (see data/replication_logs/mnsc.2023.00900.md). | Nov 1 correction: Table 5 col 2 has only firm-ATC3 and year FE (no age FE) and is eligible; the age-FE columns stay out as near-misses.

specs.code: reghdfe no_nda_atc3 piv_sub_d, a(applicant_id year#atc_level3_id) vce(cluster applicant_id atc_level3_id)
specs.outcome: no_nda_atc3 (number of the firm's active NDAs in the ATC-3 class in year t)
specs.treatment_definition: piv_sub_d = (year >= piv_yr), constructed at table_5.do line 68; piv_yr = year of the firm's first Paragraph IV challenge (earliest across its drugs, from temp_appl_no_piv_yr.dta via paragraph_iv_updated2021.dta submission dates), assigned to the ATC-3 class of the challenged drug(s); 'attacked' firm-ATC3 pairs; piv_yr < 2004 and piv_yr > 2015 dropped; unattacked ATC-3s of attacked firms dropped (line 62); missing piv_yr = never treated
specs.unit_var: applicant_id x atc_level3 (firm-therapeutic class; group id via egen atc_level3_id)
specs.fe: applicant_id (firm; group FE coarser than assignment unit) + year#atc_level3_id (calendar year x time-invariant ATC-3 class)
specs.sample_condition: year 1990-2016; firm-ATC3 cells with at least one NDA ever (max no_nda_atc3 > 0) and years from the first approved drug in the class; drop unattacked ATC3s of attacked firms; drop piv_yr > 2015; reghdfe drops 1,350 singletons
specs.data_file: replication_package_MS-BST-23-00900/temp/temp_no_ndas_per_applicant_per_atc3.dta and temp/temp_appl_no_piv_yr.dta (must be generated by supplementary_files.do from data/orange_book.dta, data/drug_with_atpcode.dta, data/paragraph_iv_updated2021.dta; temp/ folder shipped empty)
specs.notes: Requires running (or translating) the relevant blocks of supplementary_files.do (lines ~270-405) to build the firm-ATC3-year count panel. Firm FE rather than firm-ATC3 FE: treatment varies within firm across ATC-3 classes, so CSA should use firm x ATC-3 as the unit and BJS should impute with the reported FE structure. Published: -0.082 (0.025), N = 6,383 (log).
specs.exclusion_reason: lead ruling 2026-11-01: paper excluded for additional age fixed effects in every headline column; this column itself has no age FE; replicated exactly (fixest -0.0819096, SE 0.0251765, N 6,383), spec and run_spec output archived in the work directory
